messages:
mira: Quick sync — planning a 2-week microworkshop to test a new activation path: 1) launch post, 2) short workshop signups, 3) free 100-token seed, 4) prompt-template followup. Goal: measure DAU lift and 7-day activation. Thoughts?
joel: Love it. Can we A/B the seed size (100 vs 300) and the template vs no-template?
mira: Yes — split by cohort. Joel will own cohort mapping. Sam you ok to surface a dedicated quickstart in the console for workshop signups?
sam: Yep. I can spin up a /quickstart-workshop route and a prefilled prompt pack. ETA: 48h. Need copy and example prompts.
mira: Copy: "Bring your first Redwood prompt to life — join our 30m microworkshop + get a starter pack." Short landing, no gate except email + company size optional.
nana: tagging ana for analytics: we need event specs. Proposed events: workshop_signup, seed_granted, first_api_call_within_24h, prompt_template_applied, activated_7d. Also add attribution param workshop_campaign.
nana: For routing — inbound leads from LinkedIn ad -> UTM=wkshp_li, organic launch post -> UTM=wkshp_org, email -> UTM=wkshp_email. We'll push attribution into signup payload.
joel: Routing ask — can we prioritize auto-crediting for workshop signups only if company size != "student"? We want to avoid abuse.
sam: Sure. Add server-side rule: if company_size in ("0","student") then seed_size=0 else seed_size = cohort_seed.
mira: Ops-bot: schedule reminder messages to attendees and a follow-up template email 24h post-workshop.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: workshop_date=1719960000; reminders=\"24h,1h\"; followup_template=\"wkshp-activator-v1\".
nana: For benchmarks — baseline: 7d activation = 6% across recent cohorts. Hypothesis: workshop + template + 300-token seed -> +4–6pp. 100-token seed -> +2–3pp. Need N per arm ~120 to be powered.
joel: Can marketing handle 3 distribution arms? (org organic, paid LI, email). Which one do we prioritize if traffic limited?
mira: Prioritize organic + email. Paid only if we hit signups < 80/day.
sam: Quickstart route snippet (for engineering):
```
POST /api/v1/onboard/workshop-signup
{
  "email":"...",
  "company_size":"...",
  "utm":"...",
  "cohort_id":"wkshp-mar23",
}
```
Response returns seed_token_count and preset_template_id.
nana: Analytics note: include user_id mapping asap (email->user once sign in). We'll tag seed redemption as seed_redeemed event.
joel: Messaging iteration: draft 3 variants for launch post: 1) "Build with Redwood in 30m" 2) "Free starter pack + workshop" 3) "Bring your prompt — we help ship it". Mira will A/B test on the organic post.
mira: I'll prepare copy + 2 hero images. Joel can run the email variant with subject line A/B.
nana: Report cadence: daily signup counts, cohort activation rollups at 24h and 7d, funnel drop-off for template application. Dashboard tab: workshop -> seed -> first-api-call -> activated.
joel: Who's handling prompt template quality? We need a champion to make sure templates are useful and short.
sam: I can create 6 starter templates: onboarding-email, customer-support, code-assistant, ideation, summarization, grading. Ask Mira for examples per persona.
mira: Will add persona blurbs. Quick checklist: landing live (48h), console route (48h), templates (48h), analytics events wired (72h), messaging + images (24h), email ready (48h).
nana: I'll prepare the power calculation doc and a minimal looker dashboard.
joel: Risk: promo abuse. Mitigations: student/company_size filter, rate limit seeds per company, manual spot checks on suspicious signups.
mira: Agreed. Final Q: do we offer a follow-up office hours? thinking 1x/week for 3 weeks.
sam: Office hours ok. Set up Calendly link and track RSVP.
nana: Last call for blockers?
joel: None from growth.
sam: None from product.
mira: Great — I'll post the kick-off in #launches and create the agenda doc. Thanks team :rocket:
ops-bot: kickoff created -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/WKSP-321
